description: Free catalog. Returns every paid route as a JSON array with path, HTTP method, url, price in USDC, what it checks, its limits and what unpaid and unknown input do (HTTP 402 and HTTP 404 without charge). Takes no arguments. Use it when choose_route said skip but you want to browse, or to see all bundles (/transfer, /invoice, /deadline, /holidays, /cryptopay) and single checks at once. The list is long; to inspect just one route use describe_route. Read-only: it does not call any route and spends no USDC.
name: list_routes
